ORA-6 · Design contract 01 · 02 October 2026

Astronomy Hub — Unified Workspace

The viewport is the product. One calm shell. Sky and Earth as modes. Astronomy intelligence stays close to the view.

Design reference, not a working application. Sky backgrounds are captured renderer imagery; Earth uses NASA’s archived Blue Marble composite to establish geographical richness. It is not live weather or proof of provider availability. All controls and text are editable HTML. Owner authorized this repository handoff when Figma access was blocked.
